The '''Ailon''' people were sapients indigenous to [[Ailon/Legends|Ailon]]. They were famous for their military tradition, which dated back to at least [[13,000 BBY]]. To them, military training was a form of religious devotion.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9" />

==History==
Their most famous military unit, the [[Ailon Nova Guard/Legends|Ailon Nova Guard]], founded in 13,000 BBY had a military reputation equaled only by such groups as the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]]. Their belief in rule by the strong led them to be fiercely loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], though [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and other [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] Imperials held the Ailons in contempt. The Empire often hired the Ailon Nova Guard as [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], and sent them into battle expecting them to be slaughtered. Such missions were usually described as glorious battles "which only the Nova Guard could perform."<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9" /> During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], they switched their allegiance to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], aiding the invaders in their conquest of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Following the war, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Ailon was subjected to crippling economic sanctions for their actions.<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
